_comment: Which vendor .ogg files back which gameplay cue.
Same indirection as atlas-map.json (docs/51 §4): cue names are OURS, and no
code learns which pack a sound came from. Swapping to a different CC0 pack
is an edit to this file and a re-run of scripts/build-audio.mjs.
Paths are relative to assets/vendor/kenney/. A missing source is reported
and skipped — the build still succeeds and the cue is simply silent at
runtime (docs/50 §8), which is why the game runs with no audio at all.
Several cues list variants. One gunshot sample repeated ten times a second
is the machine-gun-in-a-tin-can sound; rotating three and jittering the
playback rate is what stops the ear locking onto the loop.

_sustained._note: Cues played with hold(cue,true/false) rather than one-shot. These are the only long files in the set; everything else is under 50 kB.
